declaration.preface: OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD, incorporated on February 10, 2006, is dedicated to designing and manufacturing hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic steering systems for off-highway vehicles, automotive, and marine applications. We are committed to ensuring that our procurement practices contribute to sustainable development. This policy outlines our commitment to integrating environmental and social considerations into our procurement decisions.
declaration.declaration: Ognibene India Pvt. Ltd. is committed to sustainable procurement by ensuring suppliers uphold strong environmental and social standards. We aim to reduce environmental impact and ensure fair labor practices while balancing sustainability with price, quality, and reliability in our supply chain.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all workers, employees, directors, officers, agents, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD (OIL). It covers all business activities, including procurement, sales, marketing, and any interactions with government officials, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. The policy is applicable globally, regardless of local business practices or cultural norms. This policy applies to below mentioned locations:

Supplier Environmental Practices: Ognibene India Pvt. Ltd. aims to work with suppliers to reduce waste, improve energy efficiency, and lower carbon emissions.
Supplier Social Practices: We are committed to ensuring that all suppliers adhere to fair labor standards, including providing fair wages, safe working conditions, and reasonable working hours.
Resource Efficiency: Ognibene will collaborate with suppliers to enhance resource efficiency, particularly in the use of energy, water, and materials.
Waste and Circularity: We aim to promote waste reduction and circular economy principles in our supply chain, focusing on recycling, reuse, and reducing packaging waste.
Supplier Compliance and Transparency: Ognibene India Pvt. Ltd. is committed to ensuring supplier compliance with environmental and social regulations, promoting transparency in their operations.
Supplier Capacity Building: To support suppliers in adopting sustainable practices, Ognibene will provide training, guidance, and resources.
Biannual supplier workshops on sustainable sourcing continue through 2030.
Community Engagement: We commit to engaging with local communities impacted by our supply chain operations.

targets.target: 25% of our suppliers have implemented waste reduction initiatives
at least 20% will have adopted energy efficiency measures
achieving a 10% reduction in carbon emissions
40% of key suppliers transition to renewable energy usage
100% of suppliers in high-risk regions comply with international labor standards
100% of total suppliers meet fair wage and working hour requirements
100% of direct employees and 100% of indirect supplier employees receive training on human rights and ethical conduct
30% of our key suppliers will reduce their water and material consumption by 15%
20% of suppliers adopt resource monitoring systems
a 30% reduction in non-recyclable materials used in supplier packaging is achieved
70% of suppliers implement recycling programs
achieve a 20% reduction in packaging waste
50% of suppliers integrate product life cycle or take-back initiatives
90% of our suppliers will provide annual environmental, social and governance performance reports
100% will undergo third-party sustainability audits
100% of our strategic suppliers will receive sustainability training
50% will report measurable improvements in their sustainability performance
Biannual supplier workshops on sustainable sourcing continue
100% of production sites have community engagement initiatives in place
community satisfaction scores increase by 15%
Supplier participation in local CSR and environmental programs increases by 10% annually
100% of our suppliers are required to sign and comply with our Supplier Code of Conduct to ensure alignment with our ESG principles and ethical standards.
100% of our suppliers will actively participate in ESG training programs annually, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and awareness.
We will conduct on-site supplier audits and worker feedback assessments for 100% of our critical and high-risk suppliers to ensure compliance with environmental, social, and governance standards.
100% of our suppliers will be required to complete an annual ESG self-assessment, allowing us to monitor progress, identify gaps, and collaborate on improvement plans.

responsibilities.duty: overseeing the implementation of this policy, ensuring that procurement activities align with sustainability objectives.
conduct supplier assessments and audits to ensure compliance with the outlined environmental and social standards.
collaborate with suppliers to promote sustainable practices, provide necessary guidance, and track progress toward achieving the quantitative targets outlined in the policy.

responsibilities.role: All team members involved in procurement
responsibilities.duty: integrating these standards into daily operations and supplier interactions.

policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed bi-annually by the Chief Procurement Officer (CPO) and Sustainability Manager to ensure it remains current with evolving sustainability goals and industry best practices. Necessary updates will be communicated to all stakeholders, and any required changes will be implemented promptly.
